401 Unauthorized error on embedding request when API key is invalid

```c title="C"
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "liter_llm.h"

#ifndef ALEF_TEST_PASS
#define ALEF_TEST_PASS() do { return EXIT_SUCCESS; } while (0)
#endif

int main(void) {
    const char* api_key = getenv("API_KEY");
    assert(api_key != NULL && "API_KEY must be set");
    LITERLLMAlefHandle embedding_request_handle = literllm_embedding_request_from_json("{\"input\":\"Hello world\",\"model\":\"text-embedding-3-small\"}");
    if (embedding_request_handle == 0) { ALEF_TEST_PASS(); }
    LITERLLMAlefHandle client = literllm_create_client(api_key, NULL, (uint64_t)-1, (uint32_t)-1, NULL);
    assert(client != 0 && "failed to create client");
    LITERLLMAlefHandle result = literllm_default_client_embed(client, embedding_request_handle);
    if (result != 0) { return EXIT_FAILURE; }
    literllm_embedding_request_free(embedding_request_handle);
    literllm_default_client_free(client);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
```
